home.heroTitle: Find the right outdoor system for your project.
home.heroBody: Discover premium pergolas, structural glass systems, and technical outdoor enclosures engineered for precision and built to last.

shell.placeholderNotice: Sign-in arrives in Phase 1; these details are placeholders.

dev.contrastBody: Every foreground/background pair is measured against WCAG 2.1 AA: 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text and user-interface boundaries.
dev.uiBody: Every primitive, in every variant and state. A restyle that is never rendered cannot be verified.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: Describe your project and get estimates from verified manufacturers.
register.consent: I have read and accept the terms of use and the privacy notice.
register.consentRequired: You need to accept the terms to continue.
register.doneBody: We sent a verification link to your email address. It is valid for 24 hours.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to manage your projects and offers.
login.failed: That email or password is not right.
login.slowed: Too many failed attempts. Please wait a moment.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email address and we will send a reset link.
forgot.doneBody: If an account exists for that address, we have sent the reset link. It is valid for 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Changing your password signs out every other session.
reset.doneBody: You can sign in with the new password now.
reset.invalidToken: That link is invalid or has expired
reset.invalidTokenBody: Reset links are valid for 1 hour and can be used once.

verifyEmail.title: Verifying your email address
verifyEmail.failed: That link is invalid or has expired
verifyEmail.failedBody: Verification links are valid for 24 hours and can be used once.
verifyEmail.missingToken: Open this page from the link in your email.
verifyEmail.resent: If an unverified account exists, a new link is on its way.

verifyPhone.title: Verify your phone
verifyPhone.subtitle: We will send a six-digit code to your number.
verifyPhone.codeHint: The code is valid for 5 minutes.
verifyPhone.wrongCode: That code is not right. Attempts are limited.
verifyPhone.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong attempts. Request a new code.
verifyPhone.logAdapterNotice: Development: no SMS provider is chosen yet, so the code goes to the server log.

forbidden.title: You do not have access to this page
forbidden.body: You lack the permission this action needs. You may be signed in with the wrong account.

verificationRequired.email: Verify your email address to continue.
verificationRequired.phone: Verify your phone number to continue.

commandCenter.title: Command center
commandCenter.subtitle: Work waiting on you, first. The numbers are live; an empty queue looks empty.
commandCenter.notYet: This queue arrives with its phase

catalog.title: Product catalogue
catalog.subtitle: Categories, products, attributes and options. All data — no deployment needed.
catalog.slugHint: Derived from the name when left blank. Separate per locale.
catalog.keyHint: Machine name. Stable, never translated, referenced by price books.
catalog.showIfHint: One level. Chained conditions are out of scope for V1.
catalog.impactNewProjectsOnly: Required attribute added. It applies to new projects only; existing ones stay valid.
catalog.noProducts: No products in this category yet
catalog.noAttributes: This product has no attributes yet

settings.title: Platform settings
settings.subtitle: Changed without a deployment. Every value is range-checked, and every change is written to the audit log.
settings.reasonHint: Written to the audit log. One short sentence is enough.

verification.title: Manufacturer verification
verification.subtitle: Companies waiting on a decision. Every decision needs a reason.
verification.documentNoteRequired: Say what is wrong with a rejected document.
verification.reasonHint: Sent to the company verbatim and written to the audit log. At least 10 characters.
verification.approveHint: The company becomes matchable and is notified.
verification.rejectHint: Not terminal — the company can resubmit its documents.
verification.requestHint: No status change; the company stays pending and learns what is missing.
verification.suspendHint: The company becomes read-only and drops out of search and matching.
verification.done: Decision recorded and the company notified

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Read-only. Entries are appended and cannot be deleted, here or in the database.
audit.entityIdNeedsType: Choose an entity type before searching by id.
